author: Daulton
quote:
First time I've ever bothered to write a review on metacritic. I was misled and lied to, I wasn't planning on buying another game this month because I just bought Ocarina of Time remake (an infinitely better game than this on every level) but I couldn't believe the amount of high scores this game received so I thought it has to be one of the best games of all time. So I made another purchase and purchased this game this month because I was trusting the reviews. They are flat-out lying to you. I don't know if someone paid them off, I don't know if it's fear of being ostracized. (I do know Rockstar has blacklisted publishers in the past for giving them poor reviews) I'm hoping for a class action lawsuit against Rockstar for selling a misleading, deceptive, and disappointing product. The editors are lying. The graphics look nothing even remotely close to what the previews look like. I was thinking this was going to be something spectacular that finally pushes the PS5 to its limit (it's not) It runs at the same frame rate as GTA III. It's boring, I absolutely hate the freaking story. Your character is bisexual and you get no choice in the matter. Your girlfriend is a b**** who's using you. It's loaded with propaganda. I mean I'm guessing some very wealthy people knew that this game would end up in one out of every three households and they just couldn't help but load it down with propaganda. They could have at least made it fun. They could have at least put a warning label on it about all the propaganda. They could have at least been honest and admitted that it doesn't look any better than GTA v did  that came out 13 years ago and looks nothing at all like this advertisements did. It's boring on top of all that. People warned me and I told them they don't know what they're talking about and I'll come back in a few weeks and say I told you so... now I'm going to have to apologize to those same people until then they were right, this game is not with the reviewer said it was. I'm going to delete this game and go back to finishing off my backlog starting with Metroid dread. There are just too many other games out there you could play before you waste your time (and money) with this. 
THIS IS NOT EVEN A GTA game in my opinion. The entire staff from GTA v was replaced. These aren't the same people that made GTA v and it's not a cannon GTA game in my opinion. Do not believe the so-called professional reviews they are lying to you.
